baseline_construction_method.value: Data-driven surrogate 'best demonstrated practice' (BDP) energy baseline: historical plant data are outlier-filtered and unit-variance scaled, clustered with kmeans++ into operational regimes, the 5-10th percentile centre of each cluster taken as the representative best-practice point, and a non-linear surrogate model (adapted ALAMO; weighted-least-squares selection of power/exponential basis functions via MILP, AIC-based model size) fitted to those points, then simplified by backward elimination of low-influence factors.
evidence_quote: The raw data is pretreated by mean centering and unit variance (UV) scaling to have the same range of variation of all variables. The data is then clustered to identify different operational regimes
